name: Battery Limit
author: brightwalker25
description: Cap the charge on an ASUS battery to preserve it, and raise the cap for travel with an override that expires on its own

barWidget.description: The charge cap in the bar, with presets, a slider, battery health, and a travel override that reverts itself

schema.label: Show the cap in the bar
schema.description: Print the current cap next to the glyph. With this off the widget is a glyph alone, and the cap is only visible in the panel.

schema.label: Preset caps
schema.description: The standing caps offered as one-click buttons, as percentages separated by commas. Four fit comfortably on a row. 100% is not one of these; it is the travel button underneath, which expires.

schema.label: Travel override lasts
schema.description: How long a cap raised for travel stays raised before it reverts to your standing cap on its own.

schema.label: Re-read every (ms)
schema.description: How often the panel re-reads the battery while it is open. These are local file reads, and nothing runs while the panel is closed.
